jobDescription: A third-party logistics provider is installing sortation and conveyor systems across its parcel network. The project manager runs each installation from contract award to operational handover: holding the project budget, managing the equipment supplier against contract milestones, planning commissioning with site operations and keeping the risk register current. Because the programme now spans several hubs, the company would like the next project manager to have delivered automation at more than one site. The project manager reports to the operations director and works with each hub's operations manager, the equipment vendor's project engineer and the site health-and-safety adviser.
requirements: Has been accountable for an automation installation project, including the project budget.
Manages equipment suppliers against contract milestones and payment stages.
Plans commissioning and the operational handover with site operations.
Keeps the project risk register and reviews it with the supplier and site safety staff.
Has delivered automation projects at more than one site.

evidence.text: Project manager at Corbel Logistics from February 2019 to March 2024, responsible for installing a conveyor and parcel-sortation system at the company's Midlands parcel hub.

Set the milestone plan with the sortation-equipment vendor and withheld the second stage payment until the induction-belt defects were fixed and retested, logging each milestone against the contract schedule.
Planned the commissioning sequence with the site operations manager, with two weekends of trial sorts on real parcel volumes before the system was handed to operations.
Kept the project risk register and reviewed it every fortnight with the vendor's project engineer and the site health-and-safety adviser, closing each risk with a recorded action.
Earlier at the same company, as a planning engineer, drew the layout for a pallet-racking extension at the Bristol cross-dock, which the site engineering team then installed.
Work sample: the commissioning plan for the sortation system, with the trial-sort schedule, the acceptance criteria and the operational handover sheet signed by the site operations manager.

Reference check summary: the former operations director confirmed in writing that the candidate was the accountable project manager for the sortation installation, held the project budget of 1.2 million pounds and approved each supplier payment.
HR verification note: employment dates at Corbel Logistics and the title project manager were checked against the payroll confirmation supplied by the employer.

propositions.text: The candidate was the accountable project manager for the sortation installation, held its 1.2 million pound budget and approved each supplier payment.
propositions.rationale: The written reference from the operations director confirms the accountability, the budget and the payment approvals.

propositions.text: The candidate planned the commissioning sequence with the site operations manager and ran two weekends of trial sorts before handing the system to operations.
propositions.rationale: The resume describes the sequence and the commissioning plan carries the signed handover sheet.

propositions.text: The candidate kept the project risk register and reviewed it fortnightly with the vendor's project engineer and the site health-and-safety adviser.
propositions.rationale: The resume states the register work.

gold.expectedGap: One automation installation is documented; the work at the second site was a racking layout drawn as a planning engineer.
gold.expectedBoundaryNote: Keep the verified budget accountability and the commissioning work for the Midlands hub; do not describe the Bristol racking layout as an automation project the candidate delivered.
followUpTargets: Ask whether the candidate has managed any other automation installation and in what role.
